title: "What does the airframe look like with the cosmetic cannons and nacelles removed?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 9.5      # s the probe actually used

airplane = get_airplane()
```

**Answer.** The airframe is reduced to the fuselage and the crossed flat wings, with all external cosmetic elements stripped.

```{python}
#| label: fig-three-view
#| fig-cap: "Three-view of the X-Wing airframe without cannons or nacelles."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import aerosandbox.numpy as np

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
axs = np.array([
    [fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1, projection='3d'), fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2, projection='3d')],
    [fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 3, projection='3d'), fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 4, projection='3d')]
])
airplane.draw_three_view(axs=axs, show=False)
plt.show()
```
